sc: Breathless at rest is not normal: mild breathlessness on effort is → Physiological hyperventilation (progesterone)
Faint when lying flat at 32 weeks → Supine hypotension: left lateral tilt
Diastolic murmur in a pregnant woman → Always abnormal: echocardiography
f: Plasma volume +45%, red cell mass +25% (dilutional anaemia) · cardiac output +40% · heart rate +10–15 · BP lowest at 22–24 wk · ejection systolic murmur normal
Minute ventilation +40–50% · low carbon dioxide: PaCO₂ about 4 kPa (respiratory alkalosis) · FRC −20%
GFR +50% · creatinine < 75 µmol/L · proteinuria up to 300 mg/24 h · hydronephrosis (right) · glycosuria
hCG peaks 8–10 wk · placenta takes over progesterone at 8–10 wk · hPL → insulin resistance (OGTT 24–28 wk) · TSH low in 1st trimester (hCG) · prolactin ×10
Weight gain 11.5–16 kg (normal BMI) · uterus 1000 g at term · uterine blood flow 500–750 mL/min
trap: A raised ALP is normal, a raised ALT is not · creatinine 90 µmol/L is abnormal in pregnancy · low TSH in the first trimester is usually hCG, not thyrotoxicosis
